success.description: You take a wide swing at your opponents, flattening your target and causing others to scatter. You hit your target and each enemy in your engagement for -1 damage.
As above, but you hit your target and each enemy in your engagement for +1 damage instead. The targets suffer from the Staggered condition for 2 rounds.

sigmarsComet.description: You may hurl your targets to new locations within close range, where they land prone, +1 critical damage.

conservative.requirements: Strength 6+. Melee weapon equipped. Engaged with target or within close range. The attacker is physically larger than the targets. Special: Even if the attack fails, all enemies engaged with the attacker suffer 1 fatigue.

success.description: {Dr} The towering creature takes a wide swing at its opponents, flattening its target and causing others to scatter. You hit the target and another character in the engagement for normal damage.
{Dr} As above, and you deal +1 critical to each character you strike. You hit another character of the GM’s choosing in the engagement. The targets suffer from the Staggered condition for 2 rounds.

sigmarsComet.description: All characters engaged with the target suffer 1 fatigue.

reckless.requirements: Strength 6+. Melee weapon equipped. Engaged with target or within close range. The attacker is physically larger than the targets. Special: Even if the attack fails, all enemies engaged with the attacker suffer 1 fatigue.
